Esen Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Zakarpattia Oblast, Ukraine

Demolished. This record contains a direct contradiction: it is classified as demolished, yet its own preservation-condition category and narrative both describe a cemetery that was 'barely damaged' during WWII and the postwar Soviet period, and remains fenced and protected today. What isn't in dispute is that the cemetery went out of use after WWII, since the community it served — which had grown steadily from 24 people in 1851 to its peak by 1941 — was entirely destroyed: some families were expelled to Kamenets-Podolski and murdered in 1941, and the remainder were deported to Auschwitz in mid-May 1944.
